change|0|0|4.ex: The climate here has gradually changed over the past three or four decades. 这里的气候在过去三四十年里逐渐发生了变化。

change|0|0|5.ex: Fashion is constantly changing, so nothing you buy stays new for long. 时尚不断在变，买什么都新鲜不了多久。
